scope: Panhandle & South Plains (Lubbock, Potter, Randall counties; Lubbock, Amarillo) - healthcare, mental health, school/childcare, employment, legal

records.name: StarCare 24/7 Mental Health Crisis Line
records.description_en: Call any time if you or someone you know is in a mental health crisis. StarCare offers crisis help, mobile outreach, and connects you to care.
records.description_es: Llame a cualquier hora si usted o alguien que conoce está en una crisis de salud mental. StarCare ofrece ayuda en crisis, equipos que salen a ayudar y lo conecta con atención.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Lubbock, Lynn, Hockley, Cochran, or Crosby County having a mental health crisis can call.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en los condados de Lubbock, Lynn, Hockley, Cochran o Crosby que tenga una crisis de salud mental puede llamar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis line at (806) 740-1414 or toll free (800) 687-7581. You can also call or text 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis al (806) 740-1414 o gratis al (800) 687-7581. También puede llamar o mandar un mensaje de texto al 988.
records.notes: StarCare is the state-designated Local Mental Health and IDD Authority for Lubbock, Lynn, Hockley, Cochran and Crosby counties. Toll free crisis: (800) 687-7581.

records.name: StarCare Mental Health, IDD and Substance Use Services (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: StarCare is the public mental health agency for Lubbock County. It offers outpatient mental health care, medication help, youth programs, services for people with intellectual disabilities, and substance use treatment.
records.description_es: StarCare es la agencia pública de salud mental del condado de Lubbock. Ofrece atención de salud mental, ayuda con medicinas, programas para jóvenes, servicios para personas con discapacidad intelectual y tratamiento para el uso de sustancias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Lubbock, Lynn, Hockley, Cochran, or Crosby County who need mental health or intellectual disability care. Substance use services cover 41 West Texas counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en los condados de Lubbock, Lynn, Hockley, Cochran o Crosby que necesitan atención de salud mental o de discapacidad intelectual. Los servicios para el uso de sustancias cubren 41 condados del oeste de Texas.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Lubbock, Lynn, Hockley, Cochran or Crosby County resident (mental health/IDD services)

records.how_to_apply: Call the service information and intake line at (806) 740-1421 or toll free (844) 472-8810.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de información e inscripción al (806) 740-1421 o gratis al (844) 472-8810.
records.notes: Substance use services cover 41 West Texas counties. Business line (806) 766-0310; medication refills (806) 740-1447. Cost not stated on source; ask at intake.

records.name: Texas Panhandle Centers 24-Hour Crisis Line
records.description_en: Call any time for help with a mental health or substance use crisis in the Amarillo area. A crisis call starts an assessment and help right away.
records.description_es: Llame a cualquier hora si necesita ayuda con una crisis de salud mental o de uso de sustancias en el área de Amarillo. Al llamar, le hacen una evaluación y le dan ayuda enseguida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in the upper Texas Panhandle, including Amarillo, who is in crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en crisis en la parte norte del Panhandle de Texas, incluyendo Amarillo.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 359-6699 or toll free 1-800-692-4039. You can also call or text 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 359-6699 o gratis al 1-800-692-4039. También puede llamar o mandar un mensaje de texto al 988.
records.notes: Texas Panhandle Centers is the Local Mental Health Authority and a Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic for the upper 21 Panhandle counties.

records.name: Adult Behavioral Health Outpatient Services
records.description_en: Outpatient mental health care for adults, including assessment, medication management, counseling, skills training, and help with housing and jobs.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental para adultos sin tener que quedarse en el hospital. Incluye evaluación, manejo de medicinas, consejería, clases de habilidades y ayuda con vivienda y trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults with serious mental illness such as schizophrenia, major depression, or bipolar disorder in the upper Texas Panhandle.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos con enfermedades mentales graves, como esquizofrenia, depresión mayor o trastorno bipolar, en la parte norte del Panhandle de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Amarillo Behavioral Health Clinic at (806) 337-1000 (toll free 1-800-299-3699) to start intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de salud mental de Amarillo al (806) 337-1000 (gratis al 1-800-299-3699) para empezar el proceso de inscripción.
records.cost: Based on ability to pay (fee schedule)
records.notes: Site references a Monthly Ability-to-Pay Fee Schedule. PATH program serves people experiencing homelessness.

records.name: Children's Mental Health Services
records.description_en: Mental health programs for children and families, including the Behavioral Health Program, YES Waiver, and Family and Youth Services (FAYS).
records.description_es: Programas de salud mental para niños y familias, como el Programa de Salud Conductual, YES Waiver y Servicios para Familias y Jóvenes (FAYS).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children and youth in the Amarillo area and upper Panhandle who need mental health support.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños y jóvenes en el área de Amarillo y el norte del Panhandle que necesitan apoyo de salud mental.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 358-1681 or the non-crisis line at (806) 337-1000.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 358-1681 o a la línea que no es de crisis al (806) 337-1000.
records.notes: Child and Adolescent Services clinic is at 6600 Killgore Drive, (806) 354-2191 per the locations page. Age limits not stated on source; call to ask. Crisis: (806) 359-6699.

records.name: Substance Use Services and OSAR Screening
records.description_en: Screening, referral, counseling, and outpatient treatment for alcohol and drug use. Also offers the P.A.D.R.E. program for parents of young children.
records.description_es: Evaluación, referencias, consejería y tratamiento sin internarse para el uso de alcohol y drogas. También tiene el programa P.A.D.R.E. para padres de niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: OSAR serves Texas residents without health insurance in the top 22 Panhandle counties, adolescents and up. P.A.D.R.E. is for parents with a child up to age 6 or expecting parents.
records.eligibility_summary_es: OSAR atiende a residentes de Texas sin seguro médico en los 22 condados del norte del Panhandle, desde adolescentes en adelante. P.A.D.R.E. es para padres con un niño menor de 6 años o para quienes esperan un bebé.
records.how_to_apply: Call OSAR at (806) 349-5644 for a screening, or call (806) 337-1000.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a OSAR al (806) 349-5644 para hacer una cita de evaluación (hablan inglés y español), o llame al (806) 337-1000.
records.notes: Uninsured requirement applies to OSAR screening (by appointment). General outpatient treatment is for adults 18+. P.A.D.R.E.: (806) 337-1000 or 1-800-299-3699. Hardy Street site phone per locations page: (806) 354-2191.

records.name: Homeless Services
records.description_en: Mental health outreach and support for people experiencing homelessness in Amarillo.
records.description_es: Apoyo y visitas de salud mental para personas que no tienen hogar en Amarillo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People who are homeless or at risk of homelessness and have mental health needs.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas sin hogar o en riesgo de quedarse sin hogar que tienen necesidades de salud mental.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Homeless Services office at (806) 371-7716.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de Servicios para Personas sin Hogar al (806) 371-7716.
records.notes: Hours not listed on source. Adult services page describes the PATH program for people experiencing homelessness.

records.name: Early Childhood Intervention (ECI)
records.description_en: Therapy and support for babies and toddlers with developmental delays or disabilities, such as speech, physical, and occupational therapy.
records.description_es: Terapias y apoyo para bebés y niños pequeños con retrasos en el desarrollo o discapacidades, como terapia del habla, física y ocupacional.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children from birth to age 3 with developmental delays or disabilities in Potter and Randall counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños desde que nacen hasta los 3 años con retrasos en el desarrollo o discapacidades en los condados de Potter y Randall.
records.how_to_apply: Call ECI at (806) 358-8974 to make a referral.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a ECI al (806) 358-8974 para hacer una referencia.
records.notes: Cost not stated; TPC publishes an Ability-to-Pay Fee Schedule and Charity Care Policy.

records.name: Potter County Mental Health Department
records.description_en: A Potter County government office that handles mental health matters for county residents. Call to learn what help they offer.
records.description_es: Una oficina del gobierno del condado de Potter que se encarga de asuntos de salud mental para los residentes. Llame para saber qué tipo de ayuda ofrecen.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Potter County residents.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del condado de Potter.
records.how_to_apply: Call the department for information.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina para pedir información.
records.notes: County page gives very little detail on services; call first. For crisis, use Texas Panhandle Centers crisis line or 988.

records.name: Community Health Center of Lubbock
records.description_en: A federally funded community health center with 8 clinics in Lubbock. It offers primary care, behavioral health (counseling), dental, eye care, pediatrics, women's health, lab, X-ray, pharmacy, and telehealth.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario con fondos federales y 8 clínicas en Lubbock. Ofrece atención médica general, salud mental (consejería), dental, de la vista, para niños y para mujeres, además de laboratorio, rayos X, farmacia y consultas por video.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to people in the Lubbock area, including people with low income or no insurance. A sliding fee scale is available.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para personas del área de Lubbock, incluyendo personas con bajos ingresos o sin seguro. Hay una escala de pago según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 765-2611 to make an appointment. Same-day services are offered.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 765-2611 para hacer una cita. También ofrecen servicios el mismo día.
records.notes: HHS-funded health center (FQHC). Hours listed are for the main clinic. Other sites: 96 West, Arnett Benson Medical and Dental, Chatman, Community Dental, Medical Office Plaza, Parkway, West Medical and Dental.

records.name: Heal the City Free Clinic
records.description_en: A free clinic in Amarillo for people without insurance. It offers sick visits, chronic care, a free pharmacy, lab, shots, mental health care, diabetes education, and dental, vision, and specialist referrals.
records.description_es: Una clínica gratis en Amarillo para personas sin seguro médico. Ofrece consultas por enfermedad, atención para enfermedades crónicas, farmacia gratis, laboratorio, vacunas, salud mental, educación sobre diabetes y referencias para dentista, vista y especialistas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Amarillo area who do not have health insurance.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del área de Amarillo que no tienen seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 231-0364 to make an appointment. The acute clinic is by appointment only (no walk-ins).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 231-0364 para hacer una cita. La clínica de atención inmediata es solo con cita (no aceptan personas sin cita).
records.hours: Chronic care clinic: Mon 8:30am-6pm; Tue-Thu 8:30am-5pm; Fri 8:30am-12pm. Acute clinic by appointment.
records.notes: After-hours number (806) 803-9487. Pharmacy and lab have separate hours listed on site.

records.name: Lubbock Impact Health and Wellness Ministries
records.description_en: Volunteers provide medical, eye care, and counseling help, plus food and clothing, for working families with low income.
records.description_es: Voluntarios ofrecen ayuda médica, de la vista y consejería, además de comida y ropa, para familias trabajadoras con bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For working people with low income in Lubbock.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas trabajadoras con bajos ingresos en Lubbock.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 799-4329 to ask about clinic days and how to be seen.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 799-4329 para preguntar qué días hay clínica y cómo lo pueden atender.
records.notes: Clinic hours and eligibility details are not on the homepage; see the weekly resource schedule at lubbockimpact.com/event-calendar/ or call first.

records.name: Amarillo Public Health Clinic
records.organization: City of Amarillo Public Health Department
records.description_en: The public health clinic offers shots (immunizations), testing and treatment for sexually transmitted diseases, tuberculosis services, women's health, and refugee health services.
records.description_es: La clínica de salud pública ofrece vacunas, pruebas y tratamiento para enfermedades de transmisión sexual, servicios de tuberculosis, salud de la mujer y salud para refugiados.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves people in Potter and Randall counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a personas en los condados de Potter y Randall.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 378-6300 or visit the clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 378-6300 o visite la clínica.
records.notes: Main office is at 1000 Martin Rd. Alternate phone (806) 378-6306. Fees not stated on source.

records.name: Amarillo WIC Program
records.organization: City of Amarillo Public Health Department
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and children under 5.
records.description_es: WIC da comida saludable, consejos de nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños menores de 5 años.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding (up to 1 year), or postpartum (up to 6 months) women, infants, and children under 5 with income at or below 185% of the federal poverty level and a nutrition need. Must live in Texas; U.S. citizenship is not required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho (hasta 1 año) o que tuvieron bebé hace poco (hasta 6 meses), bebés y niños menores de 5 años con ingresos iguales o menores al 185% del nivel federal de pobreza y una necesidad de nutrición. Debe vivir en Texas; no necesita ser ciudadano de EE. UU.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 371-1119 or apply online (English or Spanish) to set up an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 371-1119 o haga la solicitud en línea (en inglés o español) para hacer una cita.
records.notes: Online application available in English and Spanish. North Branch: 1500 NE 24th Ave (Tuesdays and 2nd/4th Saturdays). Canyon satellite at 55 Hunsley Rd on the 3rd Monday; also Groom, Panhandle, and Vega on the 1st Monday.

records.name: SPCAA WIC Clinics (Lubbock)
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children. SPCAA runs four WIC clinics in Lubbock.
records.description_es: WIC da comida saludable, consejos de nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños pequeños. SPCAA tiene cuatro clínicas de WIC en Lubbock.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, new moms, infants, and children under 5 who meet Texas WIC income limits (at or below 185% of the federal poverty level).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas o que dan pecho, mamás recientes, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplan con los límites de ingresos de WIC de Texas (iguales o menores al 185% del nivel federal de pobreza).
records.how_to_apply: Use the clinic finder on the SPCAA WIC website or the myWIC app to contact a Lubbock clinic (Celia Ann, Central, Freedom, or Parkway), or call SPCAA at (806) 894-6104.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el buscador de clínicas en la página de SPCAA WIC o la app myWIC para comunicarse con una clínica en Lubbock (Celia Ann, Central, Freedom o Parkway), o llame a SPCAA al (806) 894-6104.
records.notes: Clinic addresses, phones, and hours were not shown on the clinic list. Phone is an SPCAA main number (Levelland) listed on spcaa.org. SPCAA WIC office: 411 Austin Street, Levelland, TX 79336.

records.name: South Plains Food Bank
records.description_en: The regional food bank for Lubbock and the South Plains. It offers food help through partner pantries, mobile pantries, senior boxes, kids' meal programs, and SNAP application help.
records.description_es: El banco de comida regional para Lubbock y el South Plains. Ofrece comida por medio de despensas, despensas móviles, cajas para personas mayores, comidas para niños y ayuda para solicitar SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People who need food in the 19 South Plains counties, including Lubbock County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que necesitan comida en los 19 condados del South Plains, incluyendo el condado de Lubbock.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out a food assistance application or call (806) 763-3003. You can also text (806) 642-6724. For urgent needs, call 2-1-1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de ayuda con comida o llame al (806) 763-3003. También puede mandar un mensaje de texto al (806) 642-6724. Si es urgente, llame al 2-1-1.
records.notes: Also helps people losing or at risk of losing SNAP benefits. Check application status by text at (806) 642-6724.

records.name: High Plains Food Bank
records.description_en: The regional food bank for the Texas Panhandle. It supplies over 140 partner pantries and runs senior food, Kids Cafe, emergency food (TEFAP), and mobile food programs.
records.description_es: El banco de comida regional para el Panhandle de Texas. Surte a más de 140 despensas y tiene programas de comida para personas mayores, Kids Cafe, comida de emergencia (TEFAP) y comida móvil.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People who need food in 29 Texas Panhandle counties, including Potter and Randall.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que necesitan comida en 29 condados del Panhandle de Texas, incluyendo Potter y Randall.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find Food tool on the website or call (806) 374-8562 to find a pantry near you.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la herramienta "Find Food" en la página web o llame al (806) 374-8562 para encontrar una despensa cerca de usted.
records.notes: Warehouse at 815 Ross St; Kids Cafe at 2199 SE 8th Ave.

records.name: Benefit Assistance (SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, TANF application help)
records.description_en: Staff help you apply for SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, and TANF, and refer you for rent, utility, and medical help.
records.description_es: El personal le ayuda a solicitar SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP y TANF, y lo refiere a lugares que ayudan con renta, servicios públicos y gastos médicos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas Panhandle residents who need help applying for benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del Panhandle de Texas que necesitan ayuda para solicitar beneficios.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online form on the website and staff will call you to set up an appointment, or call (806) 374-8562.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario en la página web y el personal le llamará para hacer una cita, o llame al (806) 374-8562.

records.name: Utility Assistance Program
records.description_en: Helps pay utility bills to stop or prevent shut-offs, and teaches ways to save energy.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las facturas de luz y gas para evitar o detener cortes del servicio, y enseña maneras de ahorrar energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households in the Texas Panhandle service area. Call to check if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares con bajos ingresos en el área que atiende en el Panhandle de Texas. Llame para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call Panhandle Community Services at (806) 372-2531 or toll free (800) 676-4727.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Panhandle Community Services al (806) 372-2531 o gratis al (800) 676-4727.
records.notes: Source did not list exact counties or income limits; PCS references serving the top 26 counties of Texas. Also offers weatherization, Housing Choice Vouchers, transportation, and tax preparation.

records.name: Direct Client Assistance Program
records.description_en: Helps adults and seniors with utilities, food, hygiene items, eye exams and glasses, and prescriptions.
records.description_es: Ayuda a adultos y personas mayores con servicios públicos (luz, agua, gas), comida, artículos de higiene, exámenes de la vista, lentes y medicinas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults and elderly people in need in the Lubbock area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos y personas mayores con necesidad en el área de Lubbock.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 765-8475. Spanish help is available at the same number.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 765-8475. Hay ayuda en español en el mismo número.
records.notes: Hours and exact service area not listed on homepage. Email info@cclubbock.org.

records.name: Lubbock Housing Authority - Public Housing and Housing Choice Vouchers
records.description_en: Offers public housing, Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers, and a Family Self-Sufficiency program to help low-income families pay rent.
records.description_es: Ofrece vivienda pública, vales de vivienda Sección 8 (Housing Choice Vouchers) y un programa de Autosuficiencia Familiar para ayudar a familias con bajos ingresos a pagar la renta.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income families, seniors, and people with disabilities. Income generally cannot be over 50% of area median income. Must be a U.S. citizen or have eligible immigration status.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias con bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad. Por lo general, los ingresos no pueden pasar del 50% del ingreso medio del área. Debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU. o tener un estatus migratorio que califique.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Lubbock Housing Authority application portal or call (806) 776-2300.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en línea en el portal de la Autoridad de Vivienda de Lubbock o llame al (806) 776-2300.
records.notes: Address, phone and hours confirmed on lubbockha.org contact page. Waitlist may apply. Family Self-Sufficiency: (806) 776-2313.

records.name: City of Amarillo Community Development (Housing Vouchers, Rent Assistance, Homeless Services)
records.description_en: The city office runs Housing Choice Vouchers, rent help, home repair programs, and homeless services.
records.description_es: Esta oficina de la ciudad maneja los vales de vivienda (Housing Choice Vouchers), ayuda con la renta, programas de reparación de casas y servicios para personas sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Amarillo residents with low income or who are homeless. Call for rules for each program.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de Amarillo con bajos ingresos o sin hogar. Llame para saber los requisitos de cada programa.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 378-3098 or visit the office at the Simms Municipal Building during office hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 378-3098 o visite la oficina en el edificio municipal Simms durante el horario de atención.
records.address: 808 S Buchanan St, First Floor (Simms Municipal Building)
records.notes: Eligibility for each program not listed on source; call to ask. Alternate phone (806) 378-9389.

records.name: Faith City Mission Shelter
records.description_en: Overnight shelter for men, and for women with or without children, plus meals and clothing in Amarillo. Also offers longer recovery programs and a work program.
records.description_es: Albergue para pasar la noche para hombres, y para mujeres con o sin hijos, además de comida y ropa en Amarillo. También tiene programas de recuperación más largos y un programa de trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People experiencing homelessness in Amarillo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas sin hogar en Amarillo.
records.how_to_apply: Call (806) 373-6402 or go to the mission.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (806) 373-6402 o vaya a la misión.
records.notes: Faith-based nonprofit. Hours not listed on homepage; call before going.

records.name: Open Door Community Center and Supportive Housing
records.description_en: A day community center with meals, plus supportive housing and survivor housing for people leaving domestic violence or trafficking.
records.description_es: Un centro comunitario de día con comidas, además de vivienda con apoyo y vivienda para sobrevivientes que salen de violencia doméstica o trata de personas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in Lubbock experiencing poverty, homelessness, domestic violence, or sex trafficking. Religious participation is not required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en Lubbock que viven en pobreza, sin hogar, o que sufren violencia doméstica o trata sexual. No tiene que participar en actividades religiosas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the community center during open hours, or call the office at (806) 687-6876.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro comunitario durante el horario de atención o llame a la oficina al (806) 687-6876.
records.notes: Administration office is next door at 1918 13th St. Also offers vital records help.

records.name: Women's Protective Services of Lubbock - 24/7 Hotline and Shelter
records.description_en: Crisis hotline, emergency shelter, counseling, legal help, court support, and job readiness for women facing abuse and their children.
records.description_es: Línea de crisis, albergue de emergencia, consejería, ayuda legal, acompañamiento a la corte y preparación para el trabajo para mujeres que sufren abuso y sus hijos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Women experiencing domestic violence and their children in 12 West Texas counties, including Lubbock. Services are free and confidential.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres que viven violencia doméstica y sus hijos en 12 condados del oeste de Texas, incluyendo Lubbock. Los servicios son gratis y confidenciales.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24/7 hotline at (806) 747-6491.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis las 24 horas al (806) 747-6491.
records.notes: Other hotline numbers: (806) 748-5292 and toll free 1-800-736-6491. Shelter address is confidential.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Scholarships) - Workforce Solutions South Plains
records.description_en: Helps low- and moderate-income families pay for child care while parents work, go to school, or train. Enrollment is closed right now, but you can join the waitlist (average wait is about 15 months).
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias con ingresos bajos o moderados a pagar el cuidado de niños mientras los padres trabajan, estudian o toman capacitación. Ahorita la inscripción está cerrada, pero puede anotarse en la lista de espera (la espera promedio es de unos 15 meses).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Each parent must work, go to school, train, or look for work at least 25 hours a week on average. Household income must be at or below 85% of state median income (for example, about $92,041 a year for a family of 4). For children under 13. Must live in the 15-county South Plains area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cada padre debe trabajar, estudiar, capacitarse o buscar trabajo al menos 25 horas por semana en promedio. Los ingresos del hogar deben ser iguales o menores al 85% del ingreso medio del estado (por ejemplo, unos $92,041 al año para una familia de 4). Para niños menores de 13 años. Debe vivir en los 15 condados del área del South Plains.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Lives in the 15-county South Plains workforce area (includes Lubbock County)

records.how_to_apply: Join the waitlist through the Texas Child Care Connection portal, or call (806) 744-3572 for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Anótese en la lista de espera en el portal Texas Child Care Connection, o llame al (806) 744-3572 para recibir ayuda.
records.notes: Source says CCS enrollment is currently CLOSED; families can join the waitlist (average wait about 15 months). Toll free (800) 658-6284. Email childcareservices@spworkforce.org.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Scholarships) - Workforce Solutions Panhandle
records.description_en: Helps low- to moderate-income families pay for child care while parents work, go to school, or take part in training.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias con ingresos bajos o moderados a pagar el cuidado de niños mientras los padres trabajan, estudian o toman capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in the 26-county Texas Panhandle area who meet work/school rules and income limits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias en los 26 condados del Panhandle de Texas que cumplan con los requisitos de trabajo o estudio y los límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Apply through the Texas child care scholarships portal, or call (806) 372-5521 for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en el portal de becas de cuidado infantil de Texas, o llame al (806) 372-5521 para recibir ayuda.
records.notes: Hours and address are for the Amarillo center. Income limits not listed on the page. Toll free 1-877-967-5228.

records.name: SPCAA Head Start and Early Head Start
records.description_en: Free early learning for young children, with family support. Lubbock centers include Eddie Richardson Center and Carver Center.
records.description_es: Educación temprana gratis para niños pequeños, con apoyo para la familia. En Lubbock hay centros como Eddie Richardson Center y Carver Center.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Head Start is for children ages 3-4 (must be 3 by Sept 1). Early Head Start is for babies up to 30 months and pregnant women. For families with low income, and children in foster care, children who are homeless, or families getting public assistance. Children with disabilities are also served.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Head Start es para niños de 3 a 4 años (deben tener 3 años para el 1 de septiembre). Early Head Start es para bebés de hasta 30 meses y mujeres embarazadas. Para familias con bajos ingresos, y para niños en cuidado temporal (foster care), niños sin hogar o familias que reciben asistencia pública. También atienden a niños con discapacidades.
records.how_to_apply: Register online through the ChildPlus portal (English or Spanish), or call (806) 894-2207 or (806) 894-6104.
records.how_to_apply_es: Inscríbase en línea en el portal ChildPlus (en inglés o español), o llame al (806) 894-2207 o al (806) 894-6104.
records.notes: Also offers Early Head Start Child Care Partnership (ages 0-3).

records.name: Amarillo ISD Free Pre-K
records.description_en: Free pre-kindergarten for 3- and 4-year-olds in Amarillo ISD.
records.description_es: Pre-kínder gratis para niños de 3 y 4 años en el distrito escolar de Amarillo (Amarillo ISD).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children who are 3 or 4 by September 1 and who are low income, learning English, homeless, from military families, in foster care, or children of police, firefighters, or emergency responders.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños que tengan 3 o 4 años para el 1 de septiembre y que tengan bajos ingresos, estén aprendiendo inglés, no tengan hogar, sean de familias militares, estén en cuidado temporal (foster care), o sean hijos de policías, bomberos o personal de emergencias.
documents_needed: Proof of address (utility bill, lease, or mortgage)
records.how_to_apply: Find your home campus with the School Locator, then complete the online registration form. Staff will contact you to finish.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque su escuela con el localizador de escuelas (School Locator) y llene el formulario de inscripción en línea. El personal se comunicará con usted para terminar el proceso.
records.notes: Spanish-speaking contact: (806) 326-1155. AISD main line (806) 326-1000. Phone is the Early Childhood Education office.

records.name: Workforce Solutions South Plains - Lubbock Career Center
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, career services, and job training programs (WIOA).
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para encontrar trabajo, servicios de carrera y programas de capacitación laboral (WIOA).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone looking for work in the South Plains area. Training programs have extra rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que busque trabajo en el área del South Plains. Los programas de capacitación tienen requisitos adicionales.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: 15-county South Plains workforce area (includes Lubbock County)

records.how_to_apply: Visit the Lubbock career center or call (806) 765-5038. Search jobs at WorkInTexas.com.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de carreras en Lubbock o llame al (806) 765-5038. Busque trabajos en WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Toll free (866) 765-5038. Located inside Wayland Plaza.

records.name: WIOA Adult, Dislocated Worker and Youth Training
records.description_en: Job training and career help for adults, laid-off workers, and youth. Youth services include GED prep, career counseling, job skills training, and paid work experience.
records.description_es: Capacitación laboral y ayuda con su carrera para adultos, trabajadores que perdieron su empleo y jóvenes. Para jóvenes hay preparación para el GED, orientación de carrera, capacitación en habilidades de trabajo y experiencia laboral pagada.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults and dislocated workers in the area; youth programs are for ages 14-24 who live in the 15-county area and can work in the U.S.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos y trabajadores que perdieron su empleo en el área; los programas para jóvenes son para edades de 14 a 24 años que vivan en los 15 condados del área y tengan permiso para trabajar en EE. UU.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: 15-county South Plains workforce area (includes Lubbock County)

records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online WIOA application, or visit a Workforce Solutions South Plains office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de WIOA en línea, o visite una oficina de Workforce Solutions South Plains.
records.notes: Males 18+ must be registered with Selective Service. Phone is the Lubbock career center.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Panhandle - Amarillo Center
records.description_en: Free resume help, job matching, career counseling, job readiness classes, and money for job training (tuition, fees, books, supplies). Also serves youth and veterans.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis con su currículum, búsqueda de trabajo, orientación de carrera, clases de preparación para el trabajo y dinero para capacitación (colegiatura, cuotas, libros y materiales). También atiende a jóvenes y veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in the Texas Panhandle. Priority for veterans and spouses, low-income people, foster youth, and people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo en el Panhandle de Texas. Tienen prioridad los veteranos y sus esposos o esposas, personas con bajos ingresos, jóvenes que estuvieron en cuidado temporal (foster care) y personas con discapacidades.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Amarillo center or call (806) 372-5521. Search jobs at WorkInTexas.com.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de Amarillo o llame al (806) 372-5521. Busque trabajos en WorkInTexas.com.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Lubbock Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for people with low income, including evictions and housing, custody, domestic violence, debt, benefits, and wills.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis para personas con bajos ingresos, incluyendo desalojos y vivienda, custodia, violencia doméstica, deudas, beneficios y testamentos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with low income in the Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas service area. Income rules apply; you can check if you qualify online or by calling.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con bajos ingresos en el área que atiende Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas. Hay reglas de ingresos; puede revisar si califica en línea o por teléfono.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en línea o llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 1-888-529-5277.
records.notes: Does not handle criminal cases, traffic tickets, personal injury, or medical malpractice. Some issues (active lawsuits, divorce, custody, family violence) must apply by phone. Landlord-Tenant Hotline: 855-548-8457. Toll free Lubbock: 800-933-4557.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Amarillo Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for people with low income, including evictions and housing, custody, domestic violence, debt, benefits, and wills.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis para personas con bajos ingresos, incluyendo desalojos y vivienda, custodia, violencia doméstica, deudas, beneficios y testamentos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with low income in the Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas service area. Income rules apply; you can check if you qualify online or by calling.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con bajos ingresos en el área que atiende Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas. Hay reglas de ingresos; puede revisar si califica en línea o por teléfono.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en línea o llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 1-888-529-5277.
records.notes: Does not handle criminal cases, traffic tickets, personal injury, or medical malpractice. Some issues (active lawsuits, divorce, custody, family violence) must apply by phone. Landlord-Tenant Hotline: 855-548-8457. Toll free Amarillo: 800-955-6808.

records.name: Landlord-Tenant Hotline
records.description_en: A phone line for renters who need legal advice about eviction, repairs, or other landlord problems.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica para inquilinos que necesitan consejo legal sobre desalojos, reparaciones u otros problemas con el dueño.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Renters with low income in the Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas service area, including Lubbock and Amarillo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Inquilinos con bajos ingresos en el área que atiende Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas, incluyendo Lubbock y Amarillo.

records.name: Texas Tech University School of Law Clinics
records.organization: Texas Tech University School of Law
records.description_en: Law students, supervised by professors, help people with low income with family law, public benefits, civil rights, consumer, estate planning, and IRS tax problems.
records.description_es: Estudiantes de derecho, supervisados por profesores, ayudan a personas con bajos ingresos con asuntos de familia, beneficios públicos, derechos civiles, problemas de consumidor, testamentos y problemas de impuestos con el IRS.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with low income. The Tax Clinic serves low-income people in West Texas and Eastern New Mexico with IRS problems.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con bajos ingresos. La Clínica de Impuestos atiende a personas con bajos ingresos en el oeste de Texas y el este de Nuevo México que tienen problemas con el IRS.
records.how_to_apply: Call the School of Law at (806) 742-3791 to ask about clinic help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Escuela de Derecho al (806) 742-3791 para preguntar sobre la ayuda de las clínicas.
records.notes: Clinic availability depends on the school term. Direct clinic lines: Civil Practice (806) 834-6649; Family Law (806) 834-6926; Low-Income Taxpayer Clinic (806) 834-8180.

records.name: Amarillo City Transit Reduced Fare Card
records.organization: City of Amarillo - Amarillo City Transit
records.description_en: Seniors, students, and people with disabilities can ride the bus for half price with a reduced fare card.
records.description_es: Las personas mayores, estudiantes y personas con discapacidad pueden viajar en autobús a mitad de precio con una tarjeta de tarifa reducida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors, students, and people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas mayores, estudiantes y personas con discapacidad.
documents_needed: Disability: Social Security award letter or Medicare card
records.how_to_apply: Bring your documents to a transit office during business hours. Staff will make your card on the spot.
records.how_to_apply_es: Lleve sus documentos a una oficina de transporte en horario de atención. El personal le hace su tarjeta en ese momento.
records.cost: 50% off regular fares (single ride, day pass, or monthly pass)
records.notes: Second office: 801 SE 23rd Ave (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm). Riders with an ACT-Connect ID can ride fixed routes at the reduced rate without a separate card.

records.name: CitiAccess Paratransit
records.description_en: Door-to-door ride service in Lubbock for approved riders who cannot use the regular bus.
records.description_es: Servicio de transporte de puerta a puerta en Lubbock para pasajeros aprobados que no pueden usar el autobús regular.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Riders approved for CitiAccess (usually people with disabilities who cannot use the regular bus).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Pasajeros aprobados para CitiAccess (por lo general, personas con discapacidades que no pueden usar el autobús regular).
records.how_to_apply: Approved riders call customer service at (806) 775-3640 to book a ride.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si ya está aprobado, llame a servicio al cliente al (806) 775-3640 para reservar un viaje.
records.notes: Eligibility application details and reduced fare info were not on the Citibus homepage; call customer service.
